veranderings.rede: The project's protected-word list keeps 'verkeerslig' and not 'robot' for a traffic light, so one national audience understands it without explanation.

veranderings.na: 'n Kind in een van die motors
veranderings.rede: 'In een motor' reads unnaturally; 'in een van die motors' is the idiomatic way to pick one car out of the passing traffic.

veranderings.voor: Dit hang nie af van wat hy het, kan doen of glo nie.
veranderings.na: Dit hang nie af van wat hy het, wat hy kan doen of wat hy glo nie.
veranderings.rede: The three parallel parts read more clearly when each repeats 'wat hy', since 'kan doen' and 'glo' do not share the object structure of 'het'.
After a long relative clause the pronoun 'daaroor' lands far from what it refers to; naming the term makes the closing sentence easier to follow.

veranderings.voor: wat gewond langs die pad lê
veranderings.na: wat gewond langs die pad gelê het
veranderings.rede: The story is told in the past tense ('het vertel', 'het gestop'), so the relative clause should be past tense too.
'Stilhou' is the standard Afrikaans for a traveller stopping; 'stop' here leans on English.
'Boonop' and 'ekstra' say the same thing twice; 'ook ekstra' keeps the meaning without the doubling.

veranderings.voor: respek vir die mens voor hom
veranderings.na: respek vir die persoon voor hom
veranderings.rede: 'n Mens ... die mens' in one short sentence is clumsy and can be misread; 'persoon' matches 'die ander persoon' in the sentence before.

veranderings.voor: sê: 'n Mens is 'n mens deur ander mense.
veranderings.na: sê: "'n Mens is 'n mens deur ander mense."
veranderings.rede: A quoted saying after a colon takes quotation marks, as the Bible quotation in the Christendom block already does.

veranderings.voor: wens in hulle gedagtes goeie dinge vir ander toe
veranderings.na: wens ander mense in hulle gedagtes goeie dinge toe
veranderings.rede: 'Iemand iets toewens' takes the person directly, without 'vir'; 'ander mense' avoids misreading 'ander goeie dinge'.

veranderings.voor: naby hulle, en dan aan vreemdelinge
veranderings.na: naby hulle en dan aan vreemdelinge
veranderings.rede: Under the AWS 2017 there is no comma before 'en' when it joins parts of one sentence; 'en dan aan vreemdelinge' has no subject and verb of its own (the protected wording itself is left intact).
'Welkom' describes being somewhere, not moving towards it, so 'waar' is the natural relative here rather than 'waarheen'.
'Saamleer' is a compound verb written as one word, like 'saamspeel' later in the lesson.
